sources.title: PDF Ask Professor G. How to Grasp: Training-Free Cross-Gripper Grasping ...
sources.snippet: Fig. 1. Overview of the proposed training-free cross-gripper grasp synthesis framework. Given a single RGB-D observation and a URDF-specified gripper, the foundation model provides semantic conditioning to construct a strategy-conditioned search region and an executable objective, followed by CEM-based refinement for final grasp synthesis.

sources.title: AquaCap: A Training-Free Underwater Embodied Agent with Code-as-Policy
sources.snippet: Structured perception turns images into checks AquaCap-Perception supplies fields for target identity, visibility, range, geometry, estimation quality, camera status, and gripper state. A vision-language model selects the requested object from RGB input, and SAM3 produces a mask.
